verdict_lead_sentence: This build is NOGO for any clinical-facing, patient-facing, or trial-recommendation-facing output. It is APPROVED for RESEARCH_ONLY exploration of the mechanism-fit ranker within the 42-trial scored population and for SAFE_TO_DEMO exposure of the ovarian/melanoma IO gate as exploratory context.

p0_blockers.issue: The mechanism-fit ranker does not evaluate patient-vs-trial clinical eligibility. Line/stage/comorbidity/prior-therapy constraints are not scored.
p0_blockers.user_impact: A caller reading top_options might assume the patient is eligible for those trials. That inference is not supported.
p0_blockers.containment: top_options entries now emit eligibility_status=NOT_EVALUATED and NO eligibility_score field. See W1B post-strict-pipeline receipts and EXT fixture assertions 'no_eligibility_score_placeholder' + 'eligibility_status_labeled'.
p0_blockers.exact_test_required: Introduce a patient-vs-trial eligibility scorer with independent unit tests covering line-of-therapy, ECOG, prior IO, active brain metastases, EF/renal thresholds. Only then may an eligibility_score reappear.
p0_blockers.release_condition: May not be emitted as an eligibility judgement until the eligibility scorer exists and its unit tests pass.

p0_blockers.issue: p_resp is derived by the closed-form rule p = clip(0.10 + 0.70*io_axis, 0.05, 0.85). It is not a fitted response probability.
p0_blockers.user_impact: A caller reading the number 0.765 (melanoma MSI-H) or 0.10 (HGSOC baseline) might treat it as a patient-level probability of response. It is not.
p0_blockers.containment: io_engine emits p_resp_status=RULE_BASED_HEURISTIC together with p_resp_prohibited_uses = [patient_level_response_probability_claim, therapy_recommendation, benefit_risk_decision, trial_ranking_tiebreaker] and p_resp_allowed_uses = [exploratory_mechanism_context_only]. Unsupported lineages return p_resp=None. See EXT F4 / F5 / F7 assertions.
p0_blockers.exact_test_required: Replace p_resp with a calibrated predictor whose calibration curve, Brier score, and subgroup performance are held out. The estimator must not be trained on the same data used to define the axes.
p0_blockers.release_condition: May not be surfaced as a patient response probability, or used to tie-break trial ranking, until a calibrated model exists AND the prohibited_uses list is honored on all consumer surfaces.

p0_blockers.issue: trials_scored (=42) reflects the mechanism-fit projection surface. It does not represent the trial universe that a clinician / trial-finder team would enumerate.
p0_blockers.user_impact: The system emits top_options with tier + tier_position + fit but the population it draws from is not the full oncology trial universe. Callers must not be led to conclude a trial is 'the best available' from these outputs.
p0_blockers.containment: W2B coverage: total_trials=2979, moa_vectors=283, onco_populated=160, path_a_scoreable_after_join=42 (coverage number in W2B receipts). The 42 must be surfaced to callers in payload metadata as scoring_population_size.
p0_blockers.exact_test_required: Grow the joined scoring population from 42 to a documented target with per-lineage minimums. Every ranking payload MUST include scoring_population_size and the eligibility coverage of that scored subset.
p0_blockers.release_condition: top_options may not be presented as clinically recommended trials. Presentation must show 'mechanism-fit ranking, N=42 scored trials' until scope + eligibility are widened AND audited.

p1_quarantined.issue: At tier=1, multiple trials share identical clipped_fit (HGSOC/TNBC tie_size=4; MSI-H ovarian tie_size=11). The ranker breaks ties by nct_id ASC. That is deterministic and reproducible but is not clinically meaningful.
p1_quarantined.user_impact: Rank=1 within a tier says nothing beyond 'this trial's nct_id sorts earliest among ties'.
p1_quarantined.containment: PC-02 tie-safe receipts assert on (tier, tier_position, clipped_fit, tie_size_at_tier_1). Exact anchor rank is not used as a success criterion.
p1_quarantined.next_step: Add a second-tier tie-breaker feature (e.g., feasibility, trial phase, geographic proximity) or explicitly render tier=1 trials as a co-equal set on consumer surfaces.

p1_quarantined.issue: NCT03579316 (STC-1010 MSS CRC anchor) currently sits at tier=6, tier_position=9, clipped_fit=0.348 for the reference MSS + KRAS_G12C + liver-met patient.
p1_quarantined.user_impact: If a caller expected the STC-1010 program's anchor trial to lead for this patient class, it does not.
p1_quarantined.containment: PC-02 tie-safe reports STRICT_FAIL for this anchor (tier > 2). No output masks the low position.
p1_quarantined.next_step: Either enrich the MSS-CRC mechanism vector (haptenation, MSS-specific IO adjuvants) or confirm that STC-1010 is not expected to lead the ranking for this patient class.

p1_quarantined.issue: LATIFY-derived delta features remain in the data lake and are referenced by parts of the mechanism-fit surface, but have not been retroactively predicted via trial vectors.
p1_quarantined.user_impact: Any callers relying on LATIFY delta features may see values that have not been reproduced end-to-end.
p1_quarantined.containment: Per PATH A governance decision (2026-04-28), LATIFY delta quarantine remains in force pending retroactive_prediction_run.py --trial-vectors. Not resolved in this remediation.
p1_quarantined.next_step: Execute retroactive_prediction_run.py --trial-vectors; reconcile against DL-05/CT-03/PC-06 receipts.

eligibility_scoring.reason: Feature is not implemented. top_options entries emit eligibility_status=NOT_EVALUATED and no eligibility_score. The number 0.75 is no longer in the codepath.

p_resp_patient_level_probability.reason: Not a fitted response model. Callers must not read io_engine.p_resp as a patient-level probability. RULE_BASED_HEURISTIC label is attached and prohibited_uses list enumerates disallowed reads.

trial_recommendation.reason: Ranker scores mechanism-fit within a 42-trial scored population. Not the trial universe. Ranking may not be phrased as a clinical trial recommendation.

mechanism_fit_ranking_within_scored_set.reason: Executed on strict pipeline. PC-02 tie-safe: 4/5 anchors pass tier<=2 + fit>=0.20 + primary axis populated. Ties are reported. Rank=1 not used as success. Payload must render scoring_population_size and tier_position, not rank.

patient_vector_axes_from_biomarkers.reason: 18/18 W1B counterfactuals pass with the strict pipeline. P0/P1 rules fire deterministically. Fail-closed reasons are attached to fail_closed_axes.

io_regimen_gate_ovarian.reason: neopembrov_nactp regimen entry has p_low/p_high plus threshold_provenance. IO gate returns JUSTIFIED / INDETERMINATE / RULE_OUT with rationale. p_resp is a labelled heuristic.

io_regimen_gate_melanoma.reason: nivo_monotherapy_melanoma regimen entry populated with thresholds and rule-based provenance. EXT F4 emits regimen=nivo_monotherapy_melanoma with p_resp_status=RULE_BASED_HEURISTIC.

io_gate_unsupported_lineage_refusal.reason: Unknown lineage returns FAIL_CLOSED; supported-but-unregistered lineage returns NOT_APPLICABLE with p_resp=None, regimen=None, fail_closed_axes += io_regimen. EXT F2/F3/F5 all pass this contract.

input_validation_reject.reason: Malformed SomaticMutation entries are rejected by the Pydantic schema (ValidationError). Empty-vector patients route through the mechanism-fit engine without crashing (EXT F6 + F7).

permitted_today: Explore mechanism-fit vectors and axis provenance for a patient case.
Read io_engine gate = JUSTIFIED / INDETERMINATE / RULE_OUT for the two registered lineages (ovarian, melanoma) AS EXPLORATORY CONTEXT ONLY.
Inspect trial ranking within the 42-trial scored population as a mechanism-fit ordering, treating tier + tier_position (not rank) as the signal.
Verify that unsupported lineages return NOT_APPLICABLE with p_resp=None and no regimen — refusal is the safe path.
Run W1B counterfactuals, EXT fixture suite, and PC-02 tie-safe against any subsequent build to detect axis-motion regressions.
prohibited_today: Presenting the ranker's top_options as clinically eligible trials.
Presenting io_engine.p_resp as a patient-level probability of response.
Using p_resp to tie-break trial ranking on any consumer surface.
Emitting any eligibility_score field. It has been removed from the codepath — surface layers may not re-derive one from other fields.
Rendering rank=1 as clinically meaningful when tier_position=1 co-occurs with tie_size > 1.
Using LATIFY delta features until retroactive_prediction_run.py --trial-vectors reconciles CT-03 / DL-05 / PC-06.

BASELINE_executed.pre_head_source_verbatim_note: Pre-remediation _run_io_engine (commit 965ed20) returned only {risk_benefit_gate, rationale}. The values p_resp=0.15 and regimen_key='neopembrov_nactp' were passed into evaluate_io_risk_benefit for every patient regardless of lineage or biomarkers, but were NOT surfaced on the wire. 'io_p_resp: None' and 'io_regimen: None' in the pre column reflect the wire payload, not the internal argument.
